title: April 2015 Nepal earthquake
summary: A magnitude 7.8 earthquake struck near Kathmandu in central Nepal on April 25, 2015. About 9,000 people died, many thousands were injured, and over 600,000 structures were damaged or destroyed. It triggered landslides and an Everest avalanche, and prompted a state of emergency and international aid.
